name: AfterCare
tagline: A post-operative recovery tracker built in a single day across three roles: a patient check-in app, a surgeon triage portal, and an admin console with audit logs and mock EHR status.
overview: AfterCare is a post-operative recovery tracking platform. It includes a patient app, surgeon portal, and admin console. The README describes daily check-ins, pain and symptom logging, wound photo analysis simulation, medication tracking, mobility/PT tracking, messaging, triage sorting, analytics, alert thresholds, mock EHR status, audit logs, and a model registry. The project simulates a healthcare workflow across patients, clinicians, and administrators.
